beschrijving.message: Connects the Chromebook to the teacher's LANcelot: show open sites, back to LANcelot, lock to LANcelot.

vastZin.message: Your teacher locked this Chromebook to LANcelot. Other sites won't open now.

bordZin.message: Your teacher would like your attention.

uitleg.message: Your teacher can see in LANcelot which sites are open on this Chromebook, only at school.

lkUitleg.message: You are the teacher: control your class's Chromebooks here.

afstandVraag.message: Control from home too? At school, type the code from LANcelot here (Names › Chromebooks › Install).

geenAdres.message: LANcelot cannot be reached: not connected at school and no internet address (turn on the tunnel in Settings › Connector).

nietBereikbaar.message: LANcelot cannot be reached right now. Is the class PC on?

losgekoppeld.message: This Chrome was unlinked. Link again with a code.
